local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local R=A.Rules
local from,to
for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do
 local name=PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName()
 if name=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ASHINA' then from=p:GetID() elseif name=='CIVILIZATION_JAC_ODA' then to=p:GetID() end
end
assert(from and to and not Players[from]:IsHuman() and Players[to]:IsHuman() and to==Game.GetLocalPlayer(),'AI Ashina and human Oda required')
assert(#PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()==22 and Players[from]:GetCities():GetCount()>=2,'Japan houses or Ashina cities missing')
local count=0
for def in GameInfo.HeroClasses() do
 count=count+1
 assert(def.HeroClassType=='HEROCLASS_JAC_WARLORD_A' or def.HeroClassType=='HEROCLASS_JAC_WARLORD_B','non-Banseiki Hero class enabled')
end
assert(count==2,'expected exactly two Banseiki native Heroes')
local def=assert(GameInfo.HeroClasses['HEROCLASS_JAC_WARLORD_A'])
assert(def.UnitType=='UNIT_HERO_JAC_WARLORD_A','custom native Hero definition missing')
local manager=assert(A.GetHeroesManager());assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(def.Index)==-1,'test Hero already claimed')
local city=assert(Players[from]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity())
local building=manager:GetPlayerHeroOriginBuildingType(from)
if not city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(building) then city:GetBuildQueue():CreateIncompleteBuilding(building,Map.GetPlot(city:GetX(),city:GetY()):GetIndex(),100) end
assert(city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(building),'Hero origin building missing')
local before={}
for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do before[u:GetID()]=true end
manager:SetHeroDiscovered(from,def.Index,true)
manager:CreateHero(from,def.Index,city:GetX(),city:GetY())
local hero
for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if not before[u:GetID()] and u:IsHero() and u:GetHeroClassType()==def.Index then assert(not hero,'multiple new Heroes');hero=u end
end
assert(hero,'custom native Hero creation failed')
if Game.GetHeroesManager().GetHeroClaimPlayer==nil then
 Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',{Kind='FIXTURE',Token='fixture:'..def.Index..':'..hero:GetID(),Class=def.Index})
 coroutine.yield('waiting for native fixture UI publication')
end

local lifeKey=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroLifespanKey)
hero:SetProperty(lifeKey,19);hero:ChangeActionCharges(2-hero:GetActionCharges())
local record={ID='recall:person',Kind='HERO',Owner=from,Unit={Owner=from,ID=hero:GetID()},
 Contract='RECONTRACT',Loyalty=71,Relations={friend=29},Lifespan=19}
hero:SetProperty(R.PERSON_KEY,record)
Players[from]:SetProperty(R.ROSTER_KEY,{[record.ID]=record})
local plan={ID='japan-human-recall',From=from,To=to,Mode='MERGER',EntryConditionsMet=true,RelationsResolved=true,
 Leader='RECRUIT',Units={},Assets={[record.ID]='RECONTRACT'}}
for _,u in Players[from]:GetUnits():Members() do
 local snap=A.SnapshotUnit(u)
 plan.Units[R.UnitKey(from,u:GetID())]=snap.Kind=='HERO' and 'RECONTRACT'
   or snap.Kind=='PERSON' and 'RECRUIT' or snap.Kind=='GREAT_PERSON' and 'RECRUIT' or 'INCORPORATE'
end
local function works()
 local result={Total=0,Hero=0,HeroCountAvailable=Game.GetGreatWorkType~=nil}
 local ids={}
 for _,owner in ipairs({from,to}) do for id in pairs(A.OwnedGreatWorks(owner)) do ids[id]=true end end
 for id in pairs(ids) do
  result.Total=result.Total+1
  if result.HeroCountAvailable then
   local kind=GameInfo.GreatWorks[Game.GetGreatWorkType(id)]
   if kind and kind.GreatWorkObjectType=='GREATWORKOBJECT_HERO' then result.Hero=result.Hero+1 end
  end
 end
 return result
end
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RECALL_PLAN_V1',plan)
local costBefore=A.CityPurchaseCost(city,GameInfo.Yields['YIELD_FAITH'].Index,GameInfo.Units[def.UnitType].Hash)
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RECALL_EXPECT_V1',{From=from,To=to,Class=def.Index,RecordID=record.ID,
  OriginalID=hero:GetID(),Before=works(),CostBeforeAbsorption=costBefore})
return 'custom native warlord seeded for human Oda inheritance'
end)
if JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE and coroutine.status(JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE)=='suspended' then
 local ok,v=coroutine.resume(JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE);assert(ok,tostring(v))
 if coroutine.status(JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE)=='dead' then Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',nil) end
 return tostring(v)
end
return 'phase already complete'

local function ApplyAndWait(plan)
 local A=ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption
 local tx=A.Apply(plan)
 while tx.Status=='WAITING_UI' do
  Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',{Kind='TRANSFER',ID=plan.ID})
  coroutine.yield('waiting for native transfer UI publication')
  tx=A.Resume(plan.ID)
 end
 local request=A.RequestVerification(plan.ID)
 if request then
  Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',{Kind='VERIFY',ID=plan.ID})
  coroutine.yield('waiting for native verification UI publication')
 end
 return tx
end
JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE=coroutine.create(function()
local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RECALL_EXPECT_V1'))
local tx=ApplyAndWait(assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RECALL_PLAN_V1')))
assert(tx.Status=='COMPLETE' and A.Verify(tx.ID,true),'native Hero absorption failed')
local record=assert(A.GetRoster(e.To)[e.RecordID])
assert(record.Outcome=='RECONTRACT' and record.Contract=='RECONTRACT' and record.Loyalty==71 and record.Relations.friend==29,'Hero became suicide or lost person state')
assert(record.Unit.ID~=e.OriginalID and A.FindUnit(e.To,record.Unit.Token),'replacement native Hero missing')
local works={Total=0,Hero=0,HeroCountAvailable=Game.GetGreatWorkType~=nil}
for id in pairs(A.OwnedGreatWorks(e.To)) do
 works.Total=works.Total+1
 if works.HeroCountAvailable then
  local kind=GameInfo.GreatWorks[Game.GetGreatWorkType(id)]
  if kind and kind.GreatWorkObjectType=='GREATWORKOBJECT_HERO' then works.Hero=works.Hero+1 end
 end
end
assert(works.Total>=e.Before.Total and (not works.HeroCountAvailable or works.Hero>=e.Before.Hero),'Hero Great Works lost on absorption')
local origin=assert(A.GetHeroesManager():GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class))
local city=assert(Players[e.To]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
local def=assert(GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class])
e.CostAfterTransfer=A.CityPurchaseCost(city,GameInfo.Yields['YIELD_FAITH'].Index,GameInfo.Units[def.UnitType].Hash)
e.TransferID=record.Unit.ID;e.AfterTransfer=works
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_RECALL_EXPECT_V1',e)
return 'Hero transferred; Great Works total '..e.Before.Total..' -> '..works.Total..', Hero '..e.Before.Hero..' -> '..works.Hero..'; cost '..tostring(e.CostBeforeAbsorption)..' -> '..tostring(e.CostAfterTransfer)
end)

 if coroutine.status(JAC_ABSORPTION_PHASE)=='dead' then Game:SetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_FIXTURE_UI_WAIT',nil) end
 return tostring(v)
end
return 'phase already complete'
